subject: issue with installation & R version numbers

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: issue with installation & R version numbers
parts:
Is there a way to clean up R so that it doesn't confuse
users about which version is needed? I get warnings that
packages were built with older versions and users seem to
conclude that they need to update to the latest R, which
I think Jiqiang said wasn't necessary.

Also, there's this issue if somebody who knows R better than
me wants to chime in:

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/issues/153

- Bob
